Chapter 1452 Chapter 4: The Tremor Of Endless Dimensional Yuan

Chapter 1452 Chapter 4: The Tremor of Endless Dimensional Yuan

Somewhere in the vast dimensional rift.

A terrifying crack stretches across, its destination unknown. Every moment, it emits an inexplicable aura that assimilates the space in the dimensional rift, like a giant abyssal mouth devouring everything it

can.

Far from this terrifying crack, there are dimensional spaces, yet under the continuous suction of the crack, these dimensional spaces slowly move towards it.

It can be foreseen that once the dimensional spaces approach the crack, they will be completely consumed without hesitation.

"It's here."

Lin Yuan's figure appears nearby, gazing from afar at the crack that devours the universe.

"Is the target of my last trial in the first phase of thirty-six billion two thousand tribulations to completely seal this crack?"

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Since entering the Third Realm and becoming a Time Lord ten thousand years ago.

Most of Lin Yuan's energy and focus have been dedicated to the path of transcendence known as 'Infinite Tribulations.'

'Infinite Origin' has an unclear goal, as no one knows the source of time, and 'Perfect Time Being' relies too much on fate. Lin Yuan is

unwilling to gamble his destiny.

After much consideration, only 'Infinite Tribulations' seem relatively reliable among the three paths of transcendence.

Even though there may be significant risks when the road nears its

end, the early and mid-stages are quite safe, and each tribulation successfully overcome leads to a real and tangible increase in strength.

This is the feedback from the endless dimensional realm, even for someone as strong as Lin Yuan. One tribulation, ten tribulations, a hundred tribulations may not make much difference.

But the cumulative enhancements from completing ten thousand, millions, billions of tribulations are still quite substantial.

Once the objective was clear, and capable of completing the initial dozens of tribulations, and understanding the difficulty ahead.

Lin Yuan then gradually unleashed himself and started multiple hundreds of tribulations simultaneously.

Then, he sent avatars to complete them.

This is the reason Lin Yuan was able to complete thirty-six billion two thousand tribulations in just ten thousand years.

If he were to go through each tribulation individually, not even ten thousand, a hundred thousand, a million, or a billion years would be enough to pass thirty-six billion two thousand tribulations.

Of course.

Only Lin Yuan dared to simultaneously activate dozens to hundreds of tribulations.

Firstly, his strength is strong enough that the trials in the first phase of 'Infinite Tribulations' pose no difficulty for him.

Secondly, he has the 'World-Breaking Origin Force' as a safety net, even if he encounters a particularly tricky tribulation, the 'World-Breaking Origin Force' can be spent to forcibly pass.

And the facts show that in ten thousand years, Lin Yuan has never used the World-Breaking Origin Force for thirty-six billion two thousand tribulations.

He mainly relied on his own strength to overcome them.

"In the second stage of tribulations, more caution is needed."

Lin Yuan watched the terrifying crack in the distance, while planning in his mind.

In the first stage of tribulations, the goal was essentially to complete a specific target, so Lin Yuan dared to activate multiple tribulations simultaneously.

But the second stage of tribulations? There's a small chance that Lin Yuan's mental will might be dragged into a special world, requiring him to pass tests within this special world.

Similar to entering the time cycle world to become a time being.

Once such tribulations are encountered, Lin Yuan might not be able to divide his attention to manage other tribulations concurrently.

"My current strength..."

Lin Yuan felt the immense force within him, akin to dimensional

spaces, a smile emerging on his face.

The increase brought by thirty-six billion two thousand tribulations is

indeed impressive.

Moreover, combined with Lin Yuan's own cultivation, creation of the fourth Tai "Tai Su' in the 'Innate Five Great, and subsequent

exploration of the origin world.

His strength soared, far surpassing his power ten thousand years ago.

"I wonder how my strength compares to a Legendary Lord who has undergone three billion tribulations?"

Lin Yuan was quite curious.

Ten thousand years ago, the Purple Light Legendary Lord could exchange some moves with him.

But now? The Purple Light Legendary Lord is simply not his match, and Lin Yuan's virtual true form ensures he stands inherently undefeated. As for other offensive maneuvers, even a slight ripple is enough to nearly annihilate the Purple Light Legendary Lord.

"It's a pity there's no real Legendary Lord who has undergone three

billion tribulations to spar with me..."

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly, feeling a sense of regret. Although his power is fearsome, his experience over the years remains

too short.

To this day, he has never met a true Legendary Lord of the three

billion tribulations.

Legendary Lords who have undergone three billion tribulations have

almost seen the end of the transcendence road, and the Returning

Ruins Lord is at this level.

Such Legendary Lords, even a mere retreat or slumber, spans entire cycles of cataclysm, and their presence can no longer be defined by spatial dimensions; they are likely roaming in a distant past or future. Unless a significant event occurs in the present time-space, it's impossible to lure these lords back.

"But the Innate Fifth Tai..."

Deep within Lin Yuan's eyes, four interweaving powers subtly exist:

Tai Yi, Tai Chu, Tai Shi, Tai Su.

The four 'Innate Tai' are intertwining, intending to give birth to the

fifth 'Tai.'

"Take it slow."

"I still have plenty of time."

Lin Yuan contained his thoughts, continuing to observe the terrifying

crack in the distance.

"According to the Supreme Rule Dao's will in descending tribulations,

the existence of this crack opposes the endless dimensional realm's operation." Lin Yuan thought: "The source that devours everything? Even dimensional spaces are not exempt? Indeed, it stands in opposition to the endless dimensional realm."

If this terrifying crack is left unchecked, and the Supreme Rule Dao's will doesn't intervene, the consequences could be extremely dire.
